findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name OS Command Injection and Path Traversal
 * @description Checks for command injection and path traversal vulnerabilities.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/os-injection-check
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawn", "execl", "execle", "execlp", "execlpe", "execv", "execve", "execvp", "execvpe"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["open"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential system command execution or file access."
findings.hypothesis: Check for OS command injection or Path Traversal sinks in the library.

message.text: Potential system command execution or file access.
Potential system command execution or file access.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential XML Injection via String Formatting
 * @description constructing XML using string formatting can lead to XML injection if input is not escaped.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/xml-construction-formatting
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-116
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking

from DataFlow::Node node, string template
where
    (
        // Check for f-strings or format calls
        exists(DataFlow::Node formatString |
            // f-string (approximated by looking for high number of parts or specific context, but CodeQL handles this via specific nodes)
            // or .format() call
            (
                node.asExpr() instanceof StringLiteral and
                template = node.asExpr().(StringLiteral).getText() and
                (template.regexpMatch(".*<.*>.*") and template.matches("%<%"))
            )
            or
            (
                exists(Call call, Attribute attr |
                    call.getFunc() = attr and
                    attr.getName() = "format" and
                    attr.getObject() = node.asExpr() and
                    template = node.asExpr().(StringLiteral).getText() and
                    template.regexpMatch(".*<.*>.*")
                )
            )
            or
            (
                // % formatting
                 exists(BinaryExpr bin |
                    bin.getOp() instanceof Mod and
                    bin.getLeft() = node.asExpr() and
                    template = node.asExpr().(StringLiteral).getText() and
                    template.regexpMatch(".*<.*>.*")
                 )
            )
        )
    )
select node, "Potential XML construction using string formatting with template: " + template
findings.hypothesis: The library might manually construct XML strings using formatting, potentially leading to XML injection.

message.text: Potential XML construction using string formatting with template: <!--%s-->
Potential XML construction using string formatting with template: <?%s?>
